title: Hyderabad deck · fresh ten-round verification audit
rounds: Inventory and atomicity
Identify each assertion, type, duplicate and unregistered detail.
Direct evidence and authority
Read available source passages; assess whether the issuer can establish this particular assertion.
Date and current status
Separate historical observations from live status; record failed fresh retrieval and missing current records.
Numbers and chart reconciliation
Recalculate arithmetic and compare source data, chart caches and embedded workbooks.
Units, geography and denominators
Check state/city, AC/PC/municipal units, boundary vintage, fiscal stage and nominal/real distinction.
Lineage and corroboration
Identify shared publishers and upstream records; avoid counting dependent sources as independent.
Reasoning and counterevidence
Challenge causal extensions, headings, omitted events and rival explanations.
Candidate fit and attribution
Compare public role wording with owner-controlled CV; distinguish reported experience from demonstrated performance.
Feasibility and evaluation
Challenge hours, outputs, access, sampling and quality measures; retain proposals as conditional.
Traceability and exported files
Check IDs, source references, PPT/PDF wording, hyperlinks and chart representation.

findings.issue: Hours/output promises are planning assumptions without demonstrated capacity.
findings.evidence: ~10focused hours/week repeated;4 briefs/30days,2 case studies and5–8 interviews proposed. Review, translation and access effort not estimated per artifact.
findings.proposal: Use one-brief effort pilot; name owner/reviewer/input/acceptance/effort/dependency/fallback per work product. Renegotiate quantities after pilot.

findings.issue: Interview/discourse designs require explicit coverage and selection logic.
findings.evidence: Current deck correctly excludes survey percentages; HM Treasury QQE sample/design framework and Magenta Book support coverage/uncertainty review, not a universal5–8 sample rule.
findings.proposal: Document purposive-selection rationale, missing voices, corpus period, translations, consent, coding and stopping rule. Keep5–8 exploratory and conditional.

findings.issue: Quality metrics need definitions, denominators and comparable baselines.
findings.evidence: Raw corrections can increase when detection improves. Review time without scope matching is not a valid efficiency comparison.
findings.proposal: Define defects per audited assertion, correction closure denominator, review acceptance and comparable brief time. Preserve an open contradiction log.

findings.evidence: S02 public post does not confirm active acceptance or exact requisition. S25 is self-report. Current civic notification/ward polygons/office and legal status not fully established.
findings.proposal: Keep role-fit conditional; preserve CV attribution; attach dated official refresh tasks rather than implying a complete8October2026 political/legal snapshot.

findings.evidence: Locators such as “Winner reports” or “workExperience” are broad. Direct retrieval failed for4 public documents; ECI S06/S08 were subsequently readable via web.
findings.proposal: Record exact page/row/passage, publication/event/retrieval dates, stable document ID and permitted snapshot hash. Log both failed and successful routes.
